title: UTMK Official Modpack 2
description: A modpack for the "Undertale The Multiversal Killer" Discord server. Lightweight but heavy on the fun.
body:
# UTMK: Official Modpack 2

This modpack is a lightweight modpack comprising of under 200 mods that focuses on enhancing the vanilla experience as well as adding onto it. There are mods such as Macaw's Furniture, Macaw's Roofs, and so on. There are even mods that alter some portions of vanilla Minecraft, such as mostly all of the "Yung's [blank]" mods.


## Single&Multiplayer

This modpack is perfect for playing either by yourself or with plans. With many mods catered towards online play as well as many more centered around just making your Minecraft experience more ejoyable, this lightweight modpack is sure to have everything you need.

### Why play?

This isn't just another modpack, it's a community modpack. Meaning this is the official modpack for the "Undertale The Multiversal Killer" Discord server, which has a growing commmunity and currently has over 2.7k members. If you want to join the community, all you have to do is copy and paste the Discord invite link above. Minecraft gamenights are common in the server and there are even sometimes events that use this very modpack.

Our community is very chill and welcoming, even if you don't want the play the game it's based around that's fine. You are still more than welcome to come in and talk, even if you're only here for Minecraft. We only ask that you maintain the chill vibe of the server and don't become a nuissance.


### Will this modpack receive any changes over time?
Most likely. It will depend on what the community wants and whether or not the modpack is stable or optimized enough for the majority of anyone who wants to play to be able to get in and enjoy themselves.

As of right now, the modpack is in Beta but will be in full release soon depending on whether or not it's good enough.
